evidence: Directly modifies `src/index/txindex.cpp`, `src/index/base.cpp`, and related index headers to enable running txindex in pruned mode and handling pruned lookups.
rationale: Enables running txindex simultaneously with block pruning, lifting a long-standing mutual exclusion for resource-constrained nodes. As noted in the description, 'users running pruned nodes due to disk space constraints could not index transactions... without re-downloading and retaining the entire blockchain,' delivering substantial value to node operators.
